description:
Our team brings together experience in artificial intelligence, machine learning and full-stack development. 

Our project work covers space and aerospace problems. It includes a PCA-optimised SVM model that classifies solar flare intensity and a Kalman filter for aircraft height estimation. We have also built a 3D AI avatar for virtual meetings. We work in Python, JavaScript, React, Node.js and TensorFlow, and we bring that mix to ASTRA-MIND. We combine data analysis, intelligent systems.
